name: get_reports
description: Recent published flood reports within 300 m of a place in Metro Manila, from the last 180 minutes at most.

place.description: The place as the person named it. Empty when here is true.

here.description: True when the person asks about where they are now.

since_minutes.description: How far back to look, 1 to 180. Use 180 unless the person states a shorter time.

kind.description: crossing when the person asks whether to cross or go through, or whether going is risky or dangerous.

vehicle.description: heavy for a truck or a bus, on_foot for walking, light for any other vehicle or when unsure, none when none is named.
